sentences.text: Natalie Portman -LRB- born Neta-Lee Hershlag , נטע-לי הרשלג June 9 , 1981 -RRB- is an actress with dual American and Israeli citizenship .	Israeli	Israeli nationality law	American	American nationality law
Her first role was in the 1994 action thriller Léon : The Professional , opposite Jean Reno .	Jean Reno	Jean Reno
She was later cast as Padmé Amidala in the Star Wars prequel trilogy -LRB- released in 1999 , 2002 and 2005 -RRB- .	Padmé Amidala	Padmé Amidala

Born in Jerusalem to an Israeli father and American mother , Portman grew up in the eastern United States from the age of three .	Jerusalem	Jerusalem	Israeli	Israeli nationality law	American	American nationality law
She studied dancing and acting in New York , and starred in Star Wars : Episode I -- The Phantom Menace while still at high school on Long Island .	Long Island	Long Island
In 1999 , Portman enrolled at Harvard University to study psychology , alongside her work as an actress ; she completed a bachelor 's degree in 2003 .	Harvard University	Harvard University

During her studies she starred in a second Star Wars film and opened in New York City 's The Public Theater production of Anton Chekhov 's The Seagull in 2001 .	The Public Theater	The Public Theater	The Seagull	The Seagull

Portman won a Golden Globe and was nominated for an Academy Award for starring in the 2004 drama Closer , appeared in Star Wars : Episode III -- Revenge of the Sith the following year , and won a Constellation Award for Best Female Performance and the Saturn Award for Best Actress for her starring role in the political thriller V for Vendetta -LRB- 2006 -RRB- .
